aggregation_order: Pre-aggregate many-side fee/settlement/reverse tables before joining where the source query or reconciliation section implies many-to-one.
display_name: Meesho implementation — Effective Cost Per Delivered Order
filters: Use active-row and source-specified marketplace filters; scope fields remain columns/caveats only.
formula_text:
SELECT
  supplier_id,
  COUNT(*) AS orders,
  SUM(taxable_shipping + shipping_gst_18_percent
      + meesho_mall_platformfee + meesho_mall_platformfee_gst
      + fixed_fee) AS total_platform_cost,
  AVG(taxable_shipping + shipping_gst_18_percent
      + meesho_mall_platformfee + meesho_mall_platformfee_gst) AS avg_cost_per_order
FROM zs_observe.meesho_forward_expenses
WHERE CAST(is_active AS VARCHAR) = 'true'
GROUP BY supplier_id;
